Title: We're retiring Speech-to-text REST preview API v3.1-preview.1 on May 12, 2023

Body.Content:
We recently made the Speech-to-text REST API version 3.1 generally available. With this release, we'll retire the preview version v3.1-preview.1 on May 12, 2023.

To avoid service interruptions, update your code that uses the Speech-to-text Rest API version v3.1-preview.1 to version 3.1 on May 12, 2023. 

If you have questions, get answers from tech community experts from Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.

  • Under Issue type, select Technical. 
  • Under Subscription, select your subscription. 
  • Under Service, click My services, then select Cognitive Services. 
  • Under Summary, type a description of your issue. 
  • Under Problem type, select Speech to Text. 
  • Under Problem subtype, select Custom Spee
